answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 22863 Country: India Title: Is it mandatory for a person to do Wudhu before touching and reading the Holy Quran? Question: Is it mandatory for a person to do Wudhu before touching and reading the Holy Quran? Answer ID: 22863 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 919/919/M=1431) In order to touch the Holy Quran it is necessary to have wudhu. Yes, it is not necessary to have wudhu for recitation without touching. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
